entity.name: Tacey
entity.description:
Tacey is an AI order validation intelligence for Shopify stores. It activates the moment a customer pays before fulfillment begins, before your warehouse touches anything.

Every order gets read. The delivery address is validated using AI reasoning. Fraud signals are checked: billing and shipping mismatch, first-time buyer risk, freight forwarder addresses, suspicious email patterns, high-value order anomalies, and more. Tacey makes one of three decisions on every order: PASS, AUTO-RESOLVE, or FLAG.

If everything is clean, the order moves through silently. The merchant does nothing. The customer never knows Tacey was there.

If there is a problem, Tacey acts. The order is held automatically. The customer receives a correction link. They fix it. The hold releases. The warehouse sees a clean order, every time.

If the problem requires a human call, the merchant is flagged immediately — with full AI reasoning, not just an alert.

Most Shopify merchants leave an unguarded window between a customer clicking Pay and a warehouse picking the order. Addresses that autofill wrong. Unit numbers that drop. Orders that look fine in the admin but get rejected by a carrier three days later. By the time anyone notices, the label has printed and the problem has become someone's job to fix.

Tacey closes that window on every single order.

Built for merchants who take post-purchase operations seriously. Available on the Shopify App Store at tacey.app.

Built by ONDUTYOPS LLC.
